The coverage map connects each requirement in [BRIEF.md](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-wburAq/project/BRIEF.md) to planned work. Ticket letters are temporary labels.

| Requirement | Tickets | Acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Volunteer adds a visitor’s first name and repair item | D: Add visitor; C: Queue lifecycle | Valid submission creates one waiting entry; invalid input and retries are handled without duplicates |
| Repairer takes the next visitor | F: Take next; C: Atomic selection | Selection follows agreed ordering; simultaneous repairers get distinct visitors; retry after a lost response recovers the original assignment |
| Repairer marks a repair finished | G: Finish repair; C: Lifecycle | Only an active repair can finish; repeated requests preserve correct state |
| Screen shows waiting visitors and those being helped | I: Live board | Both groups reflect queue state, with clear empty and loading states |
| Board refreshes automatically | I: Live board; J: Integrated verification | Staff actions appear without manual reload; reconnect restores current data; stale responses cannot overwrite newer state |
| Text-message alerts later | Explicit deferral | No SMS implementation included in the first version |

Supporting work addresses decisions and verification needed to deliver those outcomes:

| Concern | Coverage | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Ordering, completed-entry visibility, access, privacy, retention, restart behavior | A: Owner checkpoint; implemented in C–I and verified in J | Unresolved decisions; FIFO is only a proposed assumption |
| Runnable frontend/backend and meaningful tests | B: Establish tooling | Existing manifests declare test/build tooling; execution remains unverified |
| Existing placeholder page and health endpoint | E: Completed scaffold record | Verified source files; no claim that queue features exist or tests pass |
| Volunteer and repairer usability | H: Staff-journey checkpoint | Owner reviews the working add/take/finish flow |
| Complete first-version acceptance | J: Integrated verification; K: Acceptance checkpoint | Demonstration and evidence covering every first-version requirement |

No setup files have been written. The [setup flow](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-wburAq/home/.agents/skills/story/setup-flow.md) requires explicit approval of the package before creation.
